description: This file defines the AppListFragment class for an Android application, extending a base fragment to list launcher activities and handle shortcut interactions.

classes.name: AppListFragment
classes.description: An Android fragment class that lists launcher activities, manages shortcut availability, and handles activity launches within the ShortcutLauncherDemo app.

methods.name: getActivities
methods.description: Retrieves a list of launcher activities for a specific user.

methods.name: onBindAction2
methods.description: Binds actions to a button related to shortcuts for a given launcher activity, setting click listeners if shortcuts are available.

methods.name: onLaunch
methods.description: Starts the main activity associated with a launcher activity info object.

methods.name: onAction2
methods.description: Creates and launches an intent to start a shortcut-related activity for the specified launcher activity.
